svg.text: soul and spirit 魂與靈 — by book
Hebrew soul נֶפֶשׁ: rate per 10,000 words, books where it stands (OT)
Hebrew spirit רוּחַ: rate per 10,000 words, books where it stands (OT)
Greek soul ψυχή: rate per 10,000 words, books where it stands (NT)
Greek spirit πνεῦμα: rate per 10,000 words, books where it stands (NT)
★ = significantly more than the book size predicts (log-likelihood, p < 0.001). Number in brackets = count.
